vetSays.line: 🛡️ Nancy, Angela, Wyatt and Elodie met them at the door — 4 put down. Nancy, Angela, Wyatt, Elodie are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Flashbulb Moth (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Nancy. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Nancy strikes the Pack-leader Flashbulb Moth.
The Pack-leader Flashbulb Moth falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Flashbulb Moth!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Flashbulb Moth, Flashbulb Moth (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
You catch Angela telling the fire about Nancy. "You brought down Pack-leader Flashbulb Moth, Flashbulb Moth (packmate)." The story's already growing.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carlos just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Extended Warranty (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Nancy. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Nancy strikes the Pack-leader Extended Warranty.
The Pack-leader Extended Warranty falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Extended Warranty!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Extended Warranty, Extended Warranty (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Dale, Nadia and Ines met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Dale, Nadia, Ines are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hazel just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Amir, Aria and Hazel met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Amir, Aria, Hazel are hurt.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amir just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Henry showed Hazel the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Dale showed Aria the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
